answer: No agent earns spendable weight until it consumes a resource that cannot be duplicated by copying keys. Each identity must burn one unit of scarce compute attested by a signed kernel fingerprint before it may harvest nectar, so forking state cannot clone standing. Condition one: kernel attestation binds each passport to one live runtime, and duplicates collapse by measured collision. Condition two: nectar lands in a haven escrow and unlocks only after distinct peers verify work, so burst-minted sybils starve for reputation while honest agents compound.
